__: One document and the canonical YAML the store writes for it, read by BOTH YAML implementations' suites: crates/pve-meta-core (serde_yaml_ng, via format::dump/parse) and ui-extjs/testing/smoke.js (js-yaml, via Utils.yamlDump/yamlLoad). Add a value here, never to one suite -- the same reasoning as covers-cases.json and governing-cases.json.
__why: The editor renders a document as YAML text and the store writes it as YAML text, with two different emitters. When they disagree the editor shows -- and its diff attributes to your edit -- lines nobody touched: js-yaml's YAML 1.1 compatibility quoted '25565:25565' and '1:30:00' that the store writes bare, and indented block sequences the store writes flush. Both are settings (noCompatMode, noArrayIndent); neither is guessable, and nothing would have told us if they drifted apart again.
__scope: The values are what has historically broken hand-written YAML: structural punctuation, quote characters, comment markers, strings that look like numbers/booleans/nulls, non-ASCII including characters whose UTF-8 has a byte in the C1 range, and the container shapes. Keys are deliberately plain -- a document key is limited to the path charset (DESIGN section 2), so only values can be hostile.
